messages:
Anya (SI Programs): Quick recap from today's field coach pilot run — overall really positive but a few gaps in the lab setup and the cert rubric. Notes below.
Mike R.: Thanks Anya. Can you paste the checklist where coaches hit infra setup?
Anya (SI Programs): Sure — checklist is here: https://docs.redwood.com/si/field-coach-checklist. Quick snippet: 
```
- prereq: dedicated sandbox (vpc + secrets)
- kube context: rwd-sandbox
- start script: ./scripts/si-lab-start.sh
- sample prompt set: ci/si-field-01.json
```
Jessie (Partnerships): Two coaches reported confusion around quantization guidance — they asked for "safe defaults" for 8-bit vs 4-bit on our recommended instances.
Leon C.: We should add a one-pager: "Model quantization quick wins for SIs" — I can draft that.
Anya (SI Programs): Also got feedback the certification rubric feels binary (pass/fail). Coaches want an intermediate "verified with coach" tier so partners can show progress.
Mike R.: +1 on the intermediate tier. Can we also make the rubric more example-driven (show a sample failing vs passing transcript)?
Jessie (Partnerships): Good call. Also marketplace walkthrough was skipped in two pilot sessions — we should move it earlier in the flow (before the deploy lab).
Partners Bot: New onboarding task created: ORG-3742 — Assign field coach training video to cohort.
Mike R.: Can we add a 90-minute "lab extension" option? Some partners wanted extra hands-on time.
Anya (SI Programs): Yes please — make it optional and call it "Lab + Deep Dive (90m)". Mike, can you update the schedule template?
Mike R.: On it. Will add an optional slot and update the registration form (should be a 2 hr change).
Leon C.: Starting the one-pager draft now. Will include recommended quantization defaults by instance family and a short decision tree.
Jessie (Partnerships): For the rubric, I'll convert current checklist into examples and add a small clinical scoring matrix. Also adding a short set of "red flag" transcripts to fail fast.
Anya (SI Programs): Action items summary: 
- Leon: draft quantization one-pager by EOD Friday (1790200000)
- Mike: update lab schedule + add 90m option, update reg form
- Jessie: update rubric with examples + attach test prompts
- Partners Bot: tag ORG-3742 with owners when tasks assigned
Mike R.: ETA for schedule + reg form updates: 48 hours.
Leon C.: ETA for one-pager: EOD Friday. Will post draft for review.
Jessie (Partnerships): Uploading rubric v2 now: /files/si-rubric-v2.pdf — feedback welcome.
Anya (SI Programs): One final ask — can we include a 5-question multiple-choice quiz after the training video, auto-graded so coaches get instant feedback? Keeps engagement up.
Mike R.: We can add to LMS. I'll coordinate with L&D and wire up auto-grading.
Jessie (Partnerships): Also recommend we add a short checklist for "pre-call partner readiness" that partners fill 48 hrs before. Two pilot partners were missing KMS access.
Anya (SI Programs): Great point. Add it to the reg flow, Mike.
Leon C.: Draft will include a small table: instance -> quantization safe default -> notes (e.g., amp + memory guardrails).
Mike R.: Cool. I'll ping L&D and update ORG-3742 when done.
Anya (SI Programs): Thanks team :tada: — small follow-up meeting Wednesday 10am PT to sign off on materials.
Mike R.: 10am PT works. Adding calendar invite.
Jessie (Partnerships): Thanks all, nice momentum. :raised_hands:
